blocks.label: Mensuration
blocks.text:
Surface area of a sphere $= 4\pi r^2$

Curved surface area of a cone $= \pi r \times \text{slant height}$

Volume of a sphere $= \dfrac{4}{3}\pi r^3$

blocks.label: Series: geometric
blocks.text:
Sum of the first $n$ terms: $S_n = \dfrac{a(1 - r^n)}{1 - r}$

Sum to infinity: $S_\infty = \dfrac{a}{1 - r}$, valid for $|r| < 1$

blocks.label: Trigonometry
blocks.text:
Cosine rule, triangle $ABC$: $a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc\cos A$

$\tan\theta = \dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}$

$\sin(A \pm B) = \sin A\cos B \pm \cos A\sin B$

$\cos(A \pm B) = \cos A\cos B \mp \sin A\sin B$

$\tan(A \pm B) = \dfrac{\tan A \pm \tan B}{1 \mp \tan A\tan B}$

blocks.label: Logarithms
blocks.text: Change of base: $\log_a x = \dfrac{\log_b x}{\log_b a}$
